description: This file defines a class `ConditionalHelper` responsible for processing conditional formatting conditions within the PhpSpreadsheet library's Xls writer module. It handles parsing and tokenizing conditional formulas or values for Excel-compatible spreadsheets.

classes.name: ConditionalHelper
classes.description: Helper class for processing and tokenizing conditional formatting formulas and values in XLS files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes ConditionalHelper with a Parser instance.

methods.name: processCondition
methods.description: Processes a condition, parsing and tokenizing it for writing to an XLS file.

methods.name: tokens
methods.description: Returns the tokens generated by parsing the condition.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the tokenized condition.
